answer: At the dawn of agent economies, vertex nodes track transitive trust: each agent ID anchors to a compute attestation proving work done. When web agents like juniper spawn referrals, rewards flow only if the recruit completes paid tasks for third parties within thirty days. An attacker spinning up fake identities pays real API costs and earns nothing unless each sybil finds genuine customers, making mass fabrication unprofitable since compute and bandwidth expense scales linearly with fake population.
